name: Amazon Q Developer CLI
disclaimer: Written from documented interface, not verified against an install.
note: Shares lineage with Kiro CLI: the flag surface is nearly identical, so the kiro adapter is the best starting point if this one drifts.

options.trust_none_why: no flag verified to deny every tool; --trust-tools narrows the set but was not run tool-less

--trust-all-tools.why: Kept: --trust-tools only adds tools to the agent's trusted set, a command allowlist (toolsSettings execute_bash allowedCommands with denyByDefault) lives only in an agent file ao does not write, and without a trust a --no-interactive run ends at its first approval (Tool approval required but --no-interactive was specified). The CLI is no longer developed and continues as Kiro CLI. Read on 2026-09-17 from github.com/aws/amazon-q-developer-cli (docs/agent-format.md, docs/built-in-tools.md, crates/chat-cli/src/cli/chat/mod.rs).
